title: Full-stack growth system — mid-market B2B SaaS
description: Built a unified revenue operating model from scratch for a growing B2B SaaS product. CRM architecture, SEO engine, CRO layer, winback automation and analytics stack — designed and shipped as one integrated system, not a collection of disconnected tools.
problem: Marketing was a series of one-off campaigns with no operating model underneath. CRM held contact data but no lifecycle logic. SEO was ad hoc. Winback didn't exist. There was no single place that showed where revenue came from and what to do next.
system: Designed and shipped five interconnected layers as a single operating model: CRM with lifecycle stages and lead scoring, SEO architecture with content and technical foundations, CRO system with A/B testing and conversion tracking, winback automation for churned and inactive segments, and a unified analytics layer tying all of it to revenue outcomes.
artifact: Dashboards, playbooks, automation workflows, CRM configuration, and a handoff operating manual. The system ran without me — that was the acceptance criterion.
outcome: 40% increase in organic traffic. 30% increase in qualified leads. Winback reactivated a dormant segment that had been written off. Full pipeline visibility for the first time.
